summary: The customer called to complain about a two-hour internet outage affecting their work. The agent identified the issue as a general technical fault in the area, apologized, and explained that the field team is working on it with a maximum restoration time of one hour. The customer was dissatisfied and threatened to cancel their subscription, prompting the agent to offer a free data package as compensation. The call ended with the customer accepting the update under protest.

evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Restore internet service within one hour maximum.

commitments.description: Add a free data package to the customer's number as compensation once the service returns.
